method.hash_evidence: SHA-256 computed locally with shasum -a 256 for each actual page.png, page.md and page.json. A second hash read before authoring gave the same twelve values. Image hashes also match the durable render.sha256 fields. The review is bound to these exact bytes.
method.json_locations: JSON pointers are zero-based and refer to the durable page.json for the stated page. Markdown and JSON line numbers below are one-based.
method.figure_scope: For figures 10-13, inspected labels, printed values, arrows, curves and boundaries on the original full pages against the exact figure boxes and captions recorded in durable page.md/page.json. No separate crop PNG, traced SVG, assembled lesson, modern figure, FigureSpec or product render was inspected.
excluded_scope: No earlier pages, earlier substantive reviews, PDF27 text/image or PDF32 text/image reviewed.
No original PDF container opened; its SHA below is explicitly only the value recorded in durable metadata.
No page.grid.png, templates or audit.json used as a substitute for the originals.
No pipeline rerun, modern creation, source edit, database/environment access, network/API/model call, install, test, commit, push or chat messaging.
